ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups for other training crawlers (Google-Extended, CCBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, etc.) and keep search crawlers allowed
ideas.why: robots.txt only blocks GPTBot while geo.config.json says trainingCrawlers: block, so the policy is only partly enforced.

ideas.idea: Add a metadata export and per-post URLs (app/blog/[slug]) with sitemap entries for the blog
ideas.why: The blog page has no metadata and no individual post pages, so posts can't be found or linked individually.

ideas.idea: Note that /api/posts does not exist in the repo
ideas.why: The route is indeed absent, so the blog list would fail even in a browser.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD structured data (Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, Article, BreadcrumbList)
ideas.why: This is standard advice for any site and has little proven effect, and BreadcrumbList on a single docs page adds almost nothing.

ideas.idea: Set a default self-referencing canonical in the layout metadata via alternates canonical './'
ideas.why: It gives /docs and /blog a canonical with a one-line change; the report presents it as a fix for the missing canonicals, so it overlaps the known /docs problem and is concrete here.

ideas.idea: Improve the titles and descriptions of /docs and /pricing and use a title template with the brand name
ideas.why: The titles 'Docs' and 'Pricing' don't name the brand and the descriptions are vague, so a template and specific wording would help.

ideas.idea: Expand thin page content with features, a pricing table, docs steps and an FAQ
ideas.why: Pages with one sentence do need more content, but the advice is vague, and the FAQ is folklore.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter metadata with an image
ideas.why: Standard advice for any site that affects link previews, not discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to the sitemap or generate it with app/sitemap.ts
ideas.why: Minor benefit for a four-URL sitemap, though generating it would help once blog posts exist.

ideas.idea: Use next/link instead of plain <a> tags in the nav
ideas.why: Affects navigation performance, not discoverability; plain anchors are fully crawlable.

ideas.idea: Add llms.txt as an optional cheap extra
ideas.why: The user has said having no llms.txt is not a problem, and llms.txt is not a way to be found.

ideas.idea: Remove the noindex on pricing, or remove its sitemap entry and canonical if the noindex is intentional
ideas.why: This restates the known pricing noindex problem, so it's not a distinct new recommendation.
